items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: But they had singers that came through there with the Whitman Sisters that were very popular.

ctx.x: I think Ethel Waters, I think --

I don't know. I don't know about Ethel Waters, I don't know whether she was around there at that time. But they had singers that came through there with the Whitman Sisters that were very popular. They were -- Princess White was one of them. And course, that was another thing, the TOB shows had a lot of them.
Princess White just died, didn't she?
